model.name: Deploy runbook hardening — split client-rebuild vs server-restart; verify server deploy by PID not version
model.description: Process-hardening requirement from the 2026-07-20 CONFOUND (architect 4f35bc15a->651aec409): a deploy has TWO DISTINCT steps — (a) rebuild CLIENT bundles ([r]/esbuild, live immediately) and (b) restart SERVER (Ctrl-C->npm start, REQUIRED for .ts server logic to go live). A server-side ship is NOT deployed until the node process restarts. Server-side deploy MUST be verified by the node process PID CHANGE (+ etime), NOT /api/config .version — which reads package.json per-request, is updated by a client rebuild, and is NOT restart-proof (it LIED during the confound, showing v0.7.101/102 while the 3.5h-old process ran old logic). Real improvement banked from tonight: version-string != deployed-logic.

discoverySource.note: r=rebuild != process restart; /api/config version-string lied (per-request package.json read); server-side ships confounded until a REAL restart. Runbook hardening recommended by architect + PO capture-gate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The deploy runbook documents/enforces TWO distinct steps: (a) rebuild CLIENT bundles ([r]/esbuild — live immediately); (b) restart SERVER (Ctrl-C->npm start — required for .ts server logic to go live). A server-side ship is NOT considered deployed until the node process actually restarts.

Server-side deploy verification uses the node process PID CHANGE (and etime), NOT the /api/config .version string — the version reads package.json per-request, is bumped by a client rebuild, and is NOT restart-proof (it reported v0.7.101/102 while a 3.5h-old process ran old logic during the confound).
